free_tier.stated: No free tier. The 4GB Budget VPS lists USD 6.00 a month: 2 vCores on dual Intel Xeon E5-2690 V4 or equivalent, 4GB RAM, 40GB SSD, 2TB bandwidth, 1Gbps uplink, always-on DDoS protection. A third-party post quotes coupon LETSPECIAL96 at 36% off recurring for the Toronto Budget VPS, USD 3.84 a month.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a virtual server, not an object store

retention.stated: not applicable: a live server, not stored bytes

egress.terms: 2TB bandwidth on the 4GB plan on a 1Gbps uplink; each tier lists a monthly transfer allowance and the vendor asks to be told before ordering if a workload may exceed it. No overage rate is published.

interface_detail: KVM guest with root; the order page names an EnderHost Panel and the vendor VPS page names TenantOS.
tooling: ssh; any daemon the KVM guest supports.
chaining: A cheap Toronto KVM guest at USD 3.84 a month with the coupon; the pages read state no IPv6 allocation, no NAT and no inbound filter, so those three are unverified.
binding_note: 2TB/month is the ceiling the store lists for 4GB; a 1Gbps uplink can move that allowance in hours, so the allowance fails first.

identity_cost.detail: The registration form asks for First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Phone Number, a password and a billing address; only Company Name and Street Address 2 are marked Optional, so the phone number is not optional. Whether the number is verified is not stated. A third-party post lists PayPal, Credit/Debit Card, Zelle and Razorpay (UPI) as payment methods.

reliability_note: The USD 3.84 coupon price is quoted by a third-party post, not by the vendor page read; the store page lists USD 6.00 a month.
confidence_note: The USD 6.00 price, the 2TB allowance and the 1Gbps uplink are vendor store lines read on 2026-11-03; the coupon price is reported by a third party. IPv6, NAT and inbound policy are not stated on any page read.
